verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a bulk capability is the Search API's documented "multi-query search", which lets one request cover several queries. The async SDK clients, concurrency backends and higher rate-limit tiers are developer building blocks for parallelizing calls yourself, not a bulk-operations feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented batch endpoint or batch job API for processing many items at once, bulk support for the Agent/Sonar answer endpoints, details on multi-query limits and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
